q1_issues.issue: "the executive level" carries an article, and the oblique-object rule says an article mints a witness with its kind atom (a bare mass / domain / proper name is what stays a constant), so the bare constant executive_level is not the prescribed form.

q2_gaps: a capitalized common noun used as an elliptical proper name under a definite article ("the Ministry") — the casing cue in *Names and casing* makes it a one-word capitalized name run needing a Name atom, while the definite-description rule makes it an ordinary sk_ministry_1 witness; nothing decides between them, and the name branch also leaves the entity's kind atom undefined
notes: Stative transitive "represents" correctly keeps Agent on EEAA with Theme on the unchanged object, and the of-phrase correctly routes to PartOf since an arm is a component of the ministry. Fusing central_arm plus its positional modifier genus is consistent with the adjective+noun fusing branch.
